description: Stage 1.5 of the A=4 binding-K search: the canonical AVERAGED interface operator on the naive {3,6,9} placement, via linearity (8 plain GP words, exact q-Laurent, 50 dps). Captures 77.21% of the canonical 4He trace (rel 22.79%, vs 14.7% plain), so it does NOT beat the plain baseline and the gate fails; the residual is the measured woven color-tube structure. Scope-(a); no fit.
verdict: Stage 1.5: the averaged 3-bond operator K_avg = ⊗(σ+σ⁻¹)/2 on the naive inter-nucleon interfaces gives tr_M(cp·K_avg) = 0.124286121671 vs the canonical 0.160974145442 — rel Δ = 0.2279 (77.21% captured; plain best was 14.7%). The residual 22.79% is the measured woven color-tube structure of the canonical recipe (9 averaged crossings at {1,2,4,5,6,7,10}) beyond the naive {3,6,9} placement. A=4 factorization T ≈ cp·K_avg holds to 22.79% — honest partial identification, and at this residual it does NOT improve on the 14.7% plain-best baseline, which is why the assertion below fails. No AME; no fit; nothing wired. Scope-(a).
scope: (a) — averaged 3-bond partial identification; woven-structure residual 3.8% measured

assertions.label: averaged interface improves on plain best (22.79% < 14.7%)

q0AnchorReason: q0_anchor was declared False ('no q0-dependent field'). Untrue: the characters are evaluated as chi = sum c_e * q0**e, so every published number is a function of q0. Stamped `ambiguous` rather than `proton` because this quantity STRADDLES layers: chi and the canonical tr_M target (canonical-tr-m-via-chi-cache.witness.json) are at the proton pin, while the Wenzl weights y_lambda come from wenzl-y-lambda-h12.witness.json, whose data.q0 is the CODATA-2018 MUON derivation 1.109978595554180575281594... The pin actually used for chi is in parameters.q0 below. Closing the straddle needs wenzl-y-lambda-h12 re-pinned, which has ten in-repo consumers (bean qou-9ugp).
